compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: They traveled through a desert without inhabitant, and they pitched their tents in trackless regions.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Wisdom retells travel, thirst, water, and judgment in trackless regions.
observations.label: Wisdom through trackless land

observations.body: Desert travel, thirst, water, and judgment are held within a later retelling of Israel’s journey.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Wisdom 11:1–4 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Provision for Israel and punishment of enemies remain distinct uses of water.
payload.title: A desert without inhabitant
